fouki.bio: Montréal rapper FouKi, born Léo Fougères, blends Québec rap with reggae, R&B, jazz, folk and rock influences in a playful, highly collaborative francophone catalogue.

freak heat waves.bio: Canadian duo Freak Heat Waves emerged from Medicine Hat and built an underground catalogue that moves freely through post-punk, dub, house, ambient, synth-pop and psychedelia.

friyie.bio: Toronto singer and rapper Friyie, born David Afriyie Obeng, is known for melodic hip-hop and the breakout single Money Team, which became associated with Floyd Mayweather's 2017 promotional run.

frvrfriday.bio: Rwandan-Canadian singer, rapper and producer FRVRFRIDAY, born Tommy Ruhingubugi, blends contemporary R&B and hip-hop across self-produced releases and collaborations.

gabriela bee.bio: Canadian singer-songwriter Gabriela Bee grew from social-media performances with the Bee Family into her own pop career, pairing online-native songwriting with increasingly personal solo releases.

garou.bio: Sherbrooke-born Québec singer Garou rose internationally through Notre-Dame de Paris before building a long-running francophone pop career spanning albums, touring and television.

gary beals.bio: Cherry Brook, Nova Scotia singer-songwriter Gary Beals is a soul and R&B vocalist whose career grew from Canadian Idol into Juno-nominated recordings and community-focused independent work.

ghetto concept.bio: Toronto duo Ghetto Concept, formed by Kwajo Cinqo and Dolo, helped establish the city's independent hip-hop scene in the 1990s and won consecutive Juno Awards for early singles.

ghettosocks.bio: Ottawa-born, Halifax-rooted rapper and producer Ghettosocks is a Juno-nominated Canadian underground hip-hop artist known for playful lyricism and his work with the Backburner collective.

glenn lewis.bio: Toronto-born singer-songwriter Glenn Lewis is a Grammy-nominated R&B and soul vocalist whose breakthrough album World Outside My Window established him internationally in the early 2000s.

good kid.bio: Toronto indie-rock band Good Kid makes fast, melodic guitar music shaped by internet culture, gaming communities and an independent approach to releasing and sharing music.

grandtheft.bio: Toronto producer and DJ Grandtheft, born Aaron Waisglass, works across EDM, bass music, house, hip-hop and dancehall with a club-focused, genre-fluid production style.
